new_findings.title: _strict_json accepts overflow float literals such as 1e999 as +/-inf and verbatim-copy paths keep them, so a capture can become unwritable under allow_nan=False, contradicting the docstring at client 131
evidence: client 130-137 _strict_json refuses duplicate keys and the NaN/Infinity constants (126-127) but passes no parse_float, so an out-of-range number parses to inf; the CLI-only helper _finite_float (140-144, used at 946-949) is not used here

verbatim copies of parsed values: SSE usage 289-290 into record usage (341, 366); admission 503 fields 390 (only estimated_request_cost sanitized by _finite at 389); models_response 727; binding 698; trace provenance 693

client 797 CLI write has no try: ValueError traceback, interpreter exit status 1 instead of an EXIT_CODES value and no capture.json; library write_capture (891) raises to the caller
new_findings.witness: W01 C1/C2: 1e999 and -1e999 parse to +/-inf; C3/C4 controls: Infinity and NaN refused; C5: finite 503 body gives a rejection with max_admitted_cost 32.0; C6: overflowed max_admitted_cost copied as inf; C7: overflowed estimated_request_cost sanitized to None; C8: finite write succeeds (sha256 35562eeedd5964c4b6fb3163756c0b2396047f9ebba981ee48b389437886fd29 on both Pythons); C9: _write_new raises ValueError 'Out of range float values are not JSON compliant: inf' and creates no file
new_findings.effect: a whole capture (every offered record, including failure evidence) can be lost at write time; nothing is mis-scored (fail-closed) but the all-attempts-persisted intent is violated
new_findings.trigger_condition: a producer must emit a JSON number outside the double range; common Python serving encoders are expected to emit Infinity/NaN tokens or null instead (not verified here), so reachability on the intended stack is unlikely
new_findings.disposition: non-blocking hardening: give _strict_json a parse_float that rejects non-finite values (then existing ValueError handling classifies the input as invalid) or sanitize copied fields; correct the docstring; the caller finally should persist at least an error record if write_capture raises. The same parse pattern in the deferred old-adapter metrics _strict_json (metrics 985-1001) was not assessed (A8 deferred).
